description: Dry-run a formula without saving it (add_field and update_field are what save one): checks `expression` against the database's fields and evaluates it on up to 5 recent records. Saves NOTHING. Returns valid, return_type, samples and positioned errors with a suggestion. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES preview_formula"]

database.description: Database name, api slug, or id.

expression.description: The formula, e.g. {Qty} * {Unit Price} or if({Status} = "Done", 1, 0).

field.description: An existing formula field (name, api_name or id) whose expression you are replacing.

samples.description: How many records to evaluate (default and maximum 5).

name: preview_formula
title: Preview formula
